edits.new: Each fake is generated from the published OpenAPI or AsyncAPI document of its service, and its version is pinned in the run report, so a contract change shows up as a run failure and not as a silent pass. The version of each published contract fake library the stub set is generated from is read from the contract registry at the start of the run and recorded in the report, and a run whose fake library version differs from the registry fails before any assertion; the version itself is not specified in the source documents (DOR-RWB-ITG-E4046-ITG-22). The contract version this story builds against is the version the registry pins for each of the six services, and each run records it beside the fake library version; the version numbers are not specified in the source documents (DOR-RWB-ITG-E4046-ITG-23). The ALS interface ID and transport, the booking operation in rwb-payment, the data product code, the `outbound_item` field IDs, the harness environment, the seeding set and the evidence format are not specified in the source documents (GAP-0432; ASM-0608).
